data.text:
In this workflow, we recommend nanopore samples since we are using some tools that are specified for nanopore such as: Minimap2, Nanoplot porechp and fastp.

In order to switch to illumina please remove the nanoplot step, replace porechop and fastp with cutadapt or trimmomatic, and finally replace Minimap2 with  Bowtie2.

This workflow also take single-end reads to switch to paired-end, you have to check this option in most of the tools used.

report.markdown:
# Nanopore - Preprocessing Workflow Report
Below are the results of the Preprocessing  Workflow

This workflow was run on:

```galaxy
generate_time()
```

With Galaxy version:

```galaxy
generate_galaxy_version()
```

## Workflow Inputs
A collection of all sample reads (all in the same sequence file format, e.g.: Fastq, Fastq.gz, Fastqsanger, etc.)

## Workflow Outputs

### Multi QC Report of all samples before reads quality retaining

```galaxy
history_dataset_as_image(output="multiQC_html_report_before_preprocessing")
```
### Multi QC Report of all samples after reads quality retaining

```galaxy
history_dataset_as_image(output="multiQC_html_report_after_preprocessing")
```

### Table of the total number of reads and the number of host reads

```galaxy
history_dataset_display(output="removed_hosts_percentage_tabular")
```
